code: r2_H0 <- function(start, stop, event, r) {   et <- sort(unique(stop[event == 1]))   inc <- vapply(et, function(t) {     S0 <- sum(r[start < t & stop >= t]); D <- which(stop == t & event == 1)     d <- length(D); sum(1 / (S0 - (0:(d - 1)) / d * sum(r[D])))   }, numeric(1))   cum <- cumsum(inc)   function(t) vapply(t, function(s) { k <- which(et <= s); if (length(k)) cum[max(k)] else 0 }, numeric(1)) } # By-hand stabilised weights (numerator ~ x, denominator ~ x + l), data sorted by id, time ... test_that("survival first/cens equal an independent by-hand Efron interval hazard", {   sets <- list(irregular = r2_irregular(120, 1), ties = r2_irregular(120, 2, ties = TRUE),                negative_start = r2_irregular(120, 3, start0 = -5))   for (nm in names(sets)) for (tp in c("first", "cens")) {     d <- sets[[nm]]     d <- d[sample(nrow(d)), ]   # unsorted input     e <- if (tp == "first") "a" else "cens"     ref <- r2_surv_ref(d, e, tp)     w <- r2_surv_w(d, e, tp)[match(ref$key, paste(d$id, d$time))]     expect_equal(w, unname(ref$w), tolerance = 1e-10, label = paste(nm, tp))   } })
